programDescription: Western's computer science program offers students the opportunity to specialize in various fields within CS, such as cybersecurity, AI, game development, data science, etc. It is flexible and can be combined with other degrees.
admissionCoursesNeeded: English, Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, + one of the following: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Data Management, Earth and Space Sciences, Computer Science
academicCostDetails: Some things that students might need to pay for, aside from tuition are books.
livingCostDetails: Some students might also want to live on campus, which also costs money. The cost will depend on the type of residency you choose.
interestingFacts:
1. Fact #1: Scientists from Western University (and Sasketchewan) set the stage for cobalt therapy, a cancer treatment that uses gamma rays from the isotope Cobalt-60, to penetrate into the body and eliminate tumors.
  2. Fact #2: Western has more than 382,000 alumni worldwide.
  3. Fact #3: Researchers from Western published a total of 5,960 papers in 2024.
